headline: Six Weeks, Five Companies: Defense and National Security Tech Insiders Are Buying Their Own Shares
summary: Market Updates News Commentary - Executives and directors receive stock in many ways: grants, option exercises, performance awards. None of those require them to spend their own money. An open-market purchase does. When an insider buys shares at the market price, with personal capital, and then reports the trade to regulators, it is one of the few public signals of how the people closest to a business view its stock.
